spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:**
At the time when the Lord's celestial principle was sent into spiritual combat, clothed in the outermost truth animated by [GAP-1] divine love, which he communicated to the most ancient spiritual disposition that exists [GAP-2] within that single encompassing truth — [GAP-3] he pursued and captured the selfhood, the deliberate intention of spiritual death, [GAP-4] together with all its subordinate faculties of evil.

**¶2:**
When the Lord's celestial principle ascended from the deepest hell, [GAP-5] the Divine Truth proceeding from Divine Good brought forth the dominant falsities he had captured [GAP-6] as spiritual substance, that [GAP-7] from [GAP-8] the realm of falsity from evil, so that from them he might establish a new spiritual order and form everything fitting for the Divine Itself. From that time forward, the repositories that had contained the substances of evil [GAP-9] — he devastated and laid waste the [GAP-10] and all that had dwelt within them.

**¶3:**
Just as in a stagnant state of mingled truth and falsity, the natural affections and the thoughts are caught and separated by the means of divine order, while only the residual truths remain behind together with the outward natural appearances growing from that state — so too it is with the repositories of spiritual death. The [GAP-11] Lord's celestial principle captured their deliberate intentions and their [asso]ciated evils that were [GAP-12] within them, and the empty repositories were left behind in their proper [dwell]ing state.

**¶4:**
Thus the condition of the realm of falsity from evil is such, as is that of the repositories of evil that were within it.

**¶5:**
Just as the organized form of a person's life contains many subordinate faculties within it, [GAP-13] the realm of falsity from evil possesses [GAP-14] repositories of evil from its origin, [GAP-15] comprising all [GAP-16] the subordinate faculties that depend from the one supreme ruling love of the [GAP-17] organized evil. A single originating principle is the root of them all, because they all depend from the one supreme ruling love that presides over the whole organized evil. Should any subordinate faculty be severed from the end of one of these lesser governing evils, the supreme ruling love that presides over them all remains in its place exactly as it is — [GAP-18] and one finds this organized evil still alive. All these lesser governing evils are firmly established within it. [GAP-19]

**¶6:**
When they shall sever from them [GAP-20] every one of them, these lesser [GAP-21] governing evils shall [GAP-22] become as the spiritually dead, because they might perceive [GAP-23] they are no longer firmly established [GAP-24] in the organized whole to which they were joined [GAP-25].

**¶7:**
In exactly this way, it is also the case that the repositories of falsity from evil are the same — the originating forms from which [GAP-26] falsity from evil poured forth.

---

**Translator's note on ¶5–6:** The extended image of a body with a great head and many small heads corresponds to the doctrine that all particular evils and falsities in hell are organized under one supreme ruling love (self-love), which functions as the governing principle. Subordinate evils may be separated and rendered inert, yet the ruling love persists so long as it is not itself overturned — precisely as Swedenborg teaches that vastation must reach the inmost ruling love before regeneration is complete.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: At the time when the First Man was sent to the war in the first garment of [living fire], which he gave to the first nature that exists [...] in that single garment. [And with it] he hunted Matter, the thought of death, [...] and all its other powers.

When the First Man came up from the abyss, [...] the Living Spirit brought the rulers whom he had hunted [from every] element, that [offspring] of [the land of] darkness, that he might construct from them this universe and fashion everything appropriate for the greatness. From that time on, the place of the storehouses of the elements [was emptied] he destroyed and laid waste the [land and] all that were in it.

Just like a marsh, of which the fish and birds are snared in a net, and only the waters are left behind and the reeds and the plants that grow in it, this is also the case with the storehouses of death. The [First] Man snared their counsels and [their k]in that were [in them], and the storehouses were left behind in their [dwelli]ng place.
So then, the case of the land of darkness is like this, as is that of the storehouses that were in it.

Just as the body of man has many limbs in it, [the land of darkness] has [storehouses from] its beginning [like] all [the limbs] that hang from the great head of the [body]. A single root is the root of them all, because they all hang from the great head that is on top of the body. Should a limb be cut from the tip of [the]se small [h]eads, the great head that is on top of them [al]l stays in its place the way that it is [and still] you find this person alive. Al[l] these sm[all h]eads are firmly set in it [...]

Wh[en] they will cut from them [the limbs of] all of them, these little [heads] shall [become like] the corpses, because they might see [that they shall not] be firmly set [once more] in the body, which they joined wi[th it from the beginning]
In exactly this way, it is also the case that the storehouses of darkness are the same, the things from which the [darkness gushed] forth.

fills.explanation: The editor's "living fire" is the standard Manichaean term for the First Man's garment/armor, and it corresponds precisely to divine love animating truth — fire = love, living = divine in Swedenborgian correspondence.

The First Man gave his garment of living fire to the first nature as his instrument of combat; "and with it he hunted" conveys that the garment was the means by which he pursued and captured the dark powers.
In Manichaean cosmology the Living Spirit captured rulers from each of the five dark elements; "from every element" denotes the universality of this capture across all dark substances.
The rulers and elements are what came forth from the land of darkness; "offspring" is the natural-register term for what the spiritual reading calls emanations from the realm of falsity from evil.
The editor's "the land of" darkness is the standard Manichaean designation for the realm of evil, corresponding to what Swedenborg calls the realm of falsity from evil.

After the rulers were hunted from every element, the repositories were stripped of their contents — "was emptied" describes the vastation of the storehouses, matching the spiritual sense of repositories having their evil contents removed.

The singular "it" at the end of the clause ("all that were in it") requires a singular antecedent; "the land and all that were in it" parallels the standard Manichaean phrase for the complete devastation of the dark realm.

The editor's "First" is confirmed — "The First Man" is the standard designation throughout the Kephalaia for the celestial principle sent into combat, corresponding to the Lord's celestial aspect in Swedenborg.

The editor's "in them" is confirmed — "their kin that were in them" refers to the associated evils dwelling within the storehouses, matching the spiritual sense of evils contained within repositories.
The editor's "the land of darkness" is confirmed — it is the subject of the body analogy in ¶5, corresponding to the organized realm of falsity from evil in the spiritual reading.
The editor's "storehouses from" is confirmed — "has storehouses from its beginning" parallels the spiritual sense of repositories of evil existing from the origin of the dark realm.

The body analogy compares storehouses to limbs; "like" introduces the explicit simile — "storehouses from its beginning, like all the limbs that hang from the great head" — connecting the storehouses to the body's subordinate members.
The editor's "the limbs" is confirmed — in the body analogy, "all the limbs that hang from the great head" represents all subordinate faculties depending from the supreme ruling love.
The editor's "body" is confirmed — "the great head of the body" is the central image of the extended analogy, where "body" represents the organized whole of evil under its ruling love.

The great head remains unchanged even after a limb is severed; "and still you find this person alive" expresses the persistence of the ruling love despite the removal of subordinate evils, matching the spiritual reading's "and one finds this organized evil still alive."

Continuing the body analogy, "when they will cut from them the limbs of all of them" specifies that the limbs (subordinate faculties) are being severed from all the small heads (lesser governing evils).
The editor's "heads" is confirmed — "these little heads" is the consistent term throughout ¶5–6 for the lesser governing evils subordinate to the great head.

Once all limbs are severed, the little heads "become like the corpses" — matching the spiritual reading's "become as the spiritually dead," expressing the rendering inert of governing evils stripped of their subordinate faculties.

The heads become corpses because they perceive they will no longer be reestablished; "they might see that they shall not be firmly set" matches the spiritual reading's "they might perceive they are no longer firmly established."

The severed heads see that they shall not be firmly set "once more" in the body — the inability to be re-established expresses the permanence of vastation when the ruling love's subordinate connections are destroyed.
The heads were originally "joined with it from the beginning" — referring to the primordial unity of the dark body, where all subordinate evils were connected to the organized whole from its origin.

The editor's "darkness gushed" is confirmed — "from which the darkness gushed forth" corresponds to the spiritual reading's "from which falsity from evil poured forth," expressing the emanation of evil from its repositories.
